name: @voxix/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the voxix speech service protocol v1 (streams + REST).

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.web.json
scripts.build: bun -e "await import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
